content: {"summary":"Party chat distortion and disconnections are widespread, with users reporting muffled or static mic audio and inability to hear others after recent updates [#tk_2690583] [#tk_2699993]. Many report that party chat works but their own mic fails to register, even when using different headsets or adapters, indicating a controller or adapter issue [#tk_2275025] [#tk_2595927]. Some experience audio loss on all controllers or headsets, yet party chat remains unaffected, pointing to a system-wide sound bug [#tk_2905366]. Additionally, menu navigation problems and headset feedback loops have been noted, further complicating the user experience [#tk_1181212] [#tk_2232838]"}
